description.zh:
作业的可见性，取值如下：
- PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见。
- PRIVATE（默认值）：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
description.en:
The visibility of the job. Valid values:
- PUBLIC: Visible to all users in the workspace.
- PRIVATE (default): Visible only to you and administrators in the workspace.

description.zh: 任务关联用户ID。
description.en: The user ID associated with the job.

description.zh: 调用方。
description.en: The caller.

description.zh:
任务名称，支持模糊查询，大小写不敏感，不支持通配符。
例如：输入test，可以匹配test-job1、job-test、job-test2或job-Test；但是不能匹配job-t1。
默认为空，代表任意任务名称。
description.en:
The job name. Supports fuzzy match and is case-insensitive. Wildcards are not supported.
For example, entering test matches test-job1, job-test, job-test2, or job-Test, but does not match job-t1.
Default value: empty, which indicates all job names.

description.zh: DisplayName搜索模式。默认为通配符匹配。
description.en: The search mode for DisplayName. Default value: wildcard match.

description.zh: 筛选是否启用指定节点运行的任务。
description.en: Specifies whether to filter jobs that have designated node assignment enabled.

description.zh: 查询区间的截止时间；使用任务的创建时间来过滤。默认值是当前时刻。
description.en: The end time of the query range. Jobs are filtered by creation time. Default value: the current time.

description.zh: 是否跨工作空间获取任务列表，需要配合`ShowOwn=true`参数使用，可以查询当前用户最近提交的任务列表。
description.en: Specifies whether to retrieve jobs across all workspaces. This parameter must be used together with `ShowOwn=true` to query jobs recently submitted by the current user.

description.zh: 在镜像(images)字段中进行全文检索，支持中英文分词。
description.en: Performs a full-text index retrieve in the image (images) field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization.

description.zh:
任务ID，不支持模糊查询，对大小写不敏感。不支持通配符。
默认为空，代表任意任务ID。
description.en:
The job ID. Fuzzy match is not supported. Case-insensitive. Wildcards are not supported.
Default value: empty, which indicates all job IDs.

description.zh: 任务ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号分隔。与JobId同时设置时，以JobId为准。
description.en: A list of job IDs separated by commas. If both JobIds and JobId are specified, JobId takes precedence.

description.zh:
任务类型，默认为空，代表所有类型。支持的任务类型如下：
- TFJob
- PyTorchJob
- XGBoostJob
- OneFlowJob
- ElasticBatchJob
description.en:
The job type. Default value: empty, which indicates all types. Valid values:
- TFJob
- PyTorchJob
- XGBoostJob
- OneFlowJob
- ElasticBatchJob

description.zh: 数值范围筛选的字段名。需配合NumericRangeMin/NumericRangeMax使用。
description.en: The field name for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeMin or NumericRangeMax.

description.zh: 数值范围筛选的最大值（包含）。需配合NumericRangeField使用。
description.en: The maximum value (inclusive) for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeField.

description.zh: 数值范围筛选的最小值（包含）。需配合NumericRangeField使用。
description.en: The minimum value (inclusive) for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeField.

description.zh:
排列顺序，支持：

- desc：降序，默认值。
- asc：升序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- desc: Descending order. This is the default value.
- asc: Ascending order.

description.zh:
闲时资源信息，可能的取值
- ForbiddenQuotaOverSold
- ForceQuotaOverSold
- AcceptQuotaOverSold-true （true表示作业实际使用了闲时资源）
- AcceptQuotaOverSold-false （false表示作业实际使用了保障资源）
description.en:
The off-peak resource information. Valid values:
- ForbiddenQuotaOverSold
- ForceQuotaOverSold
- AcceptQuotaOverSold-true (true indicates the job actually used off-peak resources)
- AcceptQuotaOverSold-false (false indicates the job actually used guaranteed resources)

description.zh: 分页查询，指定当前需要返回的页码，起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number for paging. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页返回的任务数量。
description.en: The number of jobs to return per page.

description.zh:
资源类型，取值如下：
- PrePaid：资源配额
- Spot：竞价资源
- PostPaid：公共资源
description.en:
The resource type. Valid values:
- PrePaid: resource quota
- Spot: preemptible resources
- PostPaid: public resources

description.zh: 过滤指定工作流ID创建的任务。
description.en: Filters jobs created by the specified workflow ID.

description.zh: 在任务失败原因(reason)字段中进行全文检索，支持中英文分词。
description.en: Performs a full-text index retrieve in the node failed reason (reason) field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization.

description.zh: 资源组ID。如何查询专有资源组ID，详情请参见[管理资源配额](~~2651299~~)。
description.en: The resource group ID. For details about how to obtain the dedicated resource group ID, see [Manage resource quotas](~~2651299~~).

description.zh: 按资源配额的名字，过滤查询任务列表。支持模糊匹配，不支持通配符。默认为空，表示不过滤资源配额。
description.en: The name of the resource quota, used to filter the job list. Supports fuzzy match. Wildcards are not supported. Default value: empty, which indicates no filtering by resource quota.

description.zh: 是否只查询当前用户提交的任务列表。
description.en: Specifies whether to return only jobs submitted by the current user.

description.zh:
排序字段：

- DisplayName
- JobType
- Status
- GmtCreateTime
- GmtFinishTime
description.en:
The field by which to sort results. Valid values:

- DisplayName
- JobType
- Status
- GmtCreateTime
- GmtFinishTime

description.zh: 查询区间的起始时间；使用任务的创建时间来过滤。默认值是当前时间减去7天，即：如果StartTime与EndTime都没有配置时，默认查询最近7天的任务列表。
description.en: The start time of the query range. Jobs are filtered by creation time. Default value: the current time minus 7 days. If neither StartTime nor EndTime is specified, jobs created in the last 7 days are returned.

description.zh:
任务运行状态，可能值：
- Creating
- Queuing
- Bidding (当前仅限灵骏Spot作业)
- EnvPreparing
- SanityChecking
- Running
- Restarting
- Stopping
- SucceededReserving
- FailedReserving
- Succeeded
- Failed
- Stopped
description.en:
The job status. Valid values:
- Creating
- Queuing
- Bidding (currently only for Lingjun Spot jobs)
- EnvPreparing
- SanityChecking
- Running
- Restarting
- Stopping
- SucceededReserving
- FailedReserving
- Succeeded
- Failed
- Stopped

description.zh: 用于过滤的标签。
description.en: The tags used for filtering.

description.zh: 模板ID，用于筛选由指定模板创建的任务。
description.en: The template ID, used to filter jobs created from the specified template.

description.zh: 指定StartTime/EndTime筛选使用的时间字段。不填默认为创建时间。
description.en: The time field used for StartTime/EndTime filtering. Default value: creation time.

description.zh: 在用户命令(user_command)字段中进行全文检索，支持中英文分词。
description.en: Performs a full-text index retrieve in the user command (user_command) field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization.

description.zh: 按任务提交者的用户ID，过滤查询任务列表。
description.en: The user ID of the job submitter, used to filter the job list.

description.zh: 按任务提交者的用户名，过滤查询任务列表。支持模糊查询，不支持通配符。默认为空，表示不过滤用户名。
description.en: The username of the job submitter, used to filter the job list. Supports fuzzy match. Wildcards are not supported. Default value: empty, which indicates no filtering by username.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。<props="china">如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。</props>
description.en: The workspace ID.<props="china"> For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).</props>
